description:
Finds the ticker when the reader gives a name, part of a ticker or an ISIN (for
        example 'Vanguard total world' gives VT), with the exchange each listing
        trades on. Use it first when a ticker is uncertain; for a list of tickers
        already written down, validate_symbols. base, when given, puts the listings in
        that currency first. Listings nobody here has checked are marked unchecked.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

query.description: A fund or company name, a ticker, or an ISIN.
query.title: Query

name: search_symbols

experimental.description: True for listings nobody here has checked.

symbol.description: Ticker as the exchange lists it; pass this to the measuring tools.

title: Find a ticker by name
